name: hitterloop
description: Node/TypeScript CLI layer for HitterLoop's swing-analysis pipeline: Supabase-backed coach editing, GCS media, Gemini-assisted drafts. Separate from and does not replace the existing Python pose3d pipeline (scripts/pose3d/).
